title: Entity catalog
responsibility: Frames and filters a category’s entities with accessible status and empty-state guidance.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.category
inputs.description: Required category used for headings, icon and explanatory text.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.rows
inputs.description: Required complete category rows before filtering.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.list
inputs.description: Required snippet receiving filtered/sorted rows to render as cards or table.

outputs.name: ExplorerIndex
outputs.description: Catalog with search empty, changed-only off and name ordering initially. Shows count status, distinct no-registry/no-match states and Show all clearing search/changed-only but preserving order. Adds verification legend and category-specific guidance.
